title: Redirect & Base URL
description: Load url_helper, use redirect() to move between controllers and methods, and configure base_url so those redirects actually work.
objectives: Load the url_helper before calling redirect()
Use redirect('controller/method') to move a user between controllers and methods
Configure base_url in config.php and explain why redirect() needs it
Trace a login-to-home redirect end to end
recap: redirect('controller/method') sends the browser to a new address, and is always the last line a method runs.
base_url() builds that address from $config['base_url'] in config.php.
check() now takes you to home(); logout() now takes you back to login().

chunks.text: Functions like redirect() live in a helper file, not in CI3's core. Helpers are not loaded until you ask for them.

check.question: Is redirect() ready to use the moment a controller starts?

chunks.text: Load it with $this->load->helper('url'); at the top of any method that will call redirect().
Skip that line and call redirect() anyway, and PHP throws Call to undefined function redirect() — a fatal error, not a silent failure.

chunks.text: redirect('auth/home') sends the browser to a new controller and method — the same controller/method path you'd type in the address bar.
Call it as the last thing a method does. Any code after redirect() never runs — the browser has already left.
